aiAssistHint: AI drafts land in this form for review — nothing is saved until you save it.
aiIntentPlaceholder: Describe the template, or how the message should change
aiPiiBlocked: AI assist was blocked: the request contains private-looking data.
bodyPlaceholder: Write the message. Wrap the parts that change in double braces, like '{{'topic'}}'.
clickSlotHint: Click a highlighted slot to fill it — the same gesture as in the composer.
copyFailed: Could not copy — the clipboard is unavailable.
deleteBody: This removes the template from this device. There is no undo.
empty: A template is a message you send a lot — write it once, mark the parts that change, and fill them in each time.
emptyRail: No templates yet — create one above.
importFailed: That file is not a template this app can read.
name: Name
newTemplateHint: Write the message once. Wrap the parts that change in double braces — '{{'topic'}}' becomes a fill-in chip when the template is used.
overwriteBody: A template file is already there. Replacing it rewrites what everyone who clones this repository gets.
paramHintPlaceholder: What belongs here — e.g. “the service to deploy”
paramsHint: Every parameter token in the message is a parameter. Type says how it is filled in; a parameter that is not required may be sent blank.
repoHint: Templates in {path} travel with the repository — edit them there and they reach the whole team. They are only offered in workspaces you trust.
saveToRepoNoRoot: There is no open workspace to save into.
saveToRepoRestricted: This workspace is not trusted, so nothing was written.
saveFailed: Could not save the template. Your edits are still here — try again.
useHint: Type / in the composer and pick “{name}”
useInChatFailed: Could not start a chat with this template — try again.
